text: Andorran snow poles are made out of **wood** and can have a variety** **of** colours** on them.
text_zh: 安道爾的雪樁由**木頭**製成，上面可能有各種**顏色**。

text: Austria uses white** **bollards, with a **black top**. The colour of the reflector is **(dark) red or dark grey**.
Many bollards also feature a small nipple-shaped black cap on the top. Bollards sometimes have a [snow pole on top](https://goo.gl/maps/kkcrsQwXxFkn52rq8).
NOTE: Slovenia and Montenegro use the same bollards, but with bright red reflectors instead of grey or dark red. Germany uses simple white bollards with grey reflectors.
text_zh: 奧地利使用白色** **路樁，帶有**黑色頂部**。反光片的顏色為**（深）紅色或深灰色**。
許多路樁頂部還有一個突起的黑色小蓋。路樁頂部有時會附有[除雪桿](https://goo.gl/maps/kkcrsQwXxFkn52rq8)。
註：斯洛維尼亞和蒙特內哥羅使用相同的路樁，但反光片為鮮紅色，而非灰色或深紅色。德國則使用帶有灰色反光片的簡約白色路樁。

text: These **yellow **natural gas poles, which resemble snow poles, are unique to Austria.
text_zh: 這些看起來像雪桿的**黃色**天然氣桿是奧地利獨有的。

text: Stripy gas and water poles reminiscent of snow poles can often be found next to the road.
NOTE: Dozens of poles of various utilities all over Europe use stripy patterns. Consider the location of the pole, as well as other clues before making a guess.
text_zh: 道路旁經常可以找到讓人聯想到雪桿的有條紋瓦斯桿和水管桿。
注意：歐洲各地許多不同公用事業的電線桿都使用條紋圖案。在進行猜測之前，請考慮電線桿的位置以及其他線索。

text: In Finland, it is common to find **orange snow poles** with a thin white band near the top.

NOTE: These are also found commonly in Norway and Sweden, but with a much [wider white band](https://i.imgur.com/R8PSzB4.png?1), lower down on the pole. They can also have multiple white bands, while Finnish snow poles usually have just one band.
text_zh: 在芬蘭，很常見到頂部附近帶有細白色條紋的**橘色雪樁**。
注意：這些在挪威和瑞典也很常見，但電線桿上有著[寬得多的白色帶子](https://i.imgur.com/R8PSzB4.png?1)，且位置較低。它們也可能有多條白色帶子，而芬蘭的雪標桿通常只有一條帶子。

text: Snow poles which have **2 long reflectors** can be found on bigger roads in Lapland.
NOTE: They can only be found in coverage from 2023 onward.
text_zh: 在拉普蘭的大型道路上可以找到帶有 **2 個長反光片**的雪樁。
註記：它們只能在 2023 年及之後的街景中找到。

text: The road east of Tornanadaska, right by the border to Slovakia, can be easily recognized by the **snow **on and along the road, combined with the bollards and the railway right next to the road.
text_zh: 托爾納納達斯卡以東、緊鄰斯洛伐克邊界的道路，可以透過路上及路旁的**積雪**，結合路樁以及緊鄰道路的鐵路輕易辨識。

text: In the northern parts of the Chugoku region, you can primarily find these basic snow poles, with either a **thin** **extended**, or **thin contracted** top. They can also sometimes be found in Iwate.
text_zh: 中國地方北部主要看得到這種基本款雪桿，頂端為**細長伸出**或**細短收合**兩種。岩手縣偶爾也有。

text: This **rocky dirt road** going to Chunkurchak is mostly high up in the snowy hills south of Bishkek. Some of the soil here has a **red tint** to it. On the [northern part](https://goo.gl/maps/v18zEDkdyTZVXwjc8) of the road, you can only see the snowy hills to the south. Also pay attention to the [red-and-white bollards](https://goo.gl/maps/fWt1rsU4FZ8wA5Z47) on the sides of the roads.
text_zh: 這條通往春丘克（Chunkurchak）的**岩石土路**大多位於比什凱克南方覆雪丘陵的高處。這裡的一些土壤帶有**紅色調**。在道路的[北部地區](https://goo.gl/maps/v18zEDkdyTZVXwjc8)，你只能看到南邊的雪山。同時也要注意路邊的[紅白相間路樁](https://goo.gl/maps/fWt1rsU4FZ8wA5Z47)。

text: Norwegian snow poles are typically orange, with a **fairly** **thin** white reflector. The reflector is normally toward the **middle** of the pole.

NOTE: [Swedish](https://www.google.se/maps/@61.9908262,14.5790953,3a,39.6y,258.06h,61.21t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s1qT_52M1QOthv1f9cvsoXw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) snow poles typically have a wider reflector slightly higher up, and [Finnish](https://www.google.com/maps/@60.4814738,23.2577925,3a,15y,68.45h,69.44t,0.35r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s7-wUFACQ9NzGxHQu6ngnUw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192) snow poles have their reflector at the very top.
text_zh: 挪威雪桿通常是橘色的，配有**相當****細**的白色反光片。反光片通常朝向電桿的**中間**。

注意：[瑞典](https://www.google.se/maps/@61.9908262,14.5790953,3a,39.6y,258.06h,61.21t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s1qT_52M1QOthv1f9cvsoXw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)雪桿通常具有較寬的反光片且位置稍高，而[芬蘭](https://www.google.com/maps/@60.4814738,23.2577925,3a,15y,68.45h,69.44t,0.35r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s7-wUFACQ9NzGxHQu6ngnUw!2e0!7i16384!8i8192)雪桿的反光片則位於最頂端。

text: It is also fairly common to find thin **wooden** snow poles with painted reflectors.
NOTE: While wooden snow poles can be found in [other Nordic countries](https://goo.gl/maps/ebwqngpn358DdBpp9), they will typically not have reflectors.
text_zh: 找到帶有塗漆反光片的細長**木製**雪桿也相當常見。
注意：雖然木製雪桿可以在[其他北歐國家](https://goo.gl/maps/ebwqngpn358DdBpp9)找到，但它們通常不會有反光片。

text: **Black snow poles** are most commonly found between Bergen and Trondheim.
text_zh: **黑色雪桿**最常在卑爾根和特倫漢姆之間找到。

text: The Serra da Estrela natural park can be recognised by the **rocky mountainous highland landscape**, often combined with yellow and black striped snow poles.
text_zh: Serra da Estrela 自然公園可以透過**多岩石的山區高原景觀**來識別，通常伴隨著黃黑相間的雪樁。

text: [White car long antenna](https://maps.app.goo.gl/szUNXBWMYPjJ6jMA6) is found in many places, most commonly in [southern Chelyabinsk](https://maps.app.goo.gl/u2ofsEtYhTK1kxpr9), on [snow coverage around Novosibirsk](https://goo.gl/maps/WT1mwvr1mZH9Nsy88), and in the [Far East](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UcNfar31Lf4yD8pD7) beginning in [Amur Oblast](https://maps.app.goo.gl/uJivjvnTnNdf4LHq5).

NOTE: While [Kamchatka](https://goo.gl/maps/vbKvMrHXtE7anj636) technically has a silver car (with a B type antenna), it often appears white and is part of the small group of exceptions to black and white.
text_zh: [白色長天線車](https://maps.app.goo.gl/szUNXBWMYPjJ6jMA6)在許多地方都可以見到，最常見於[車里雅賓斯克南部](https://maps.app.goo.gl/u2ofsEtYhTK1kxpr9)、[新西伯利亞周邊的雪地覆蓋路段](https://goo.gl/maps/WT1mwvr1mZH9Nsy88)，以及從[阿穆爾州](https://maps.app.goo.gl/UcNfar31Lf4yD8pD7)開始的[遠東地區](https://maps.app.goo.gl/uJivjvnTnNdf4LHq5)。
注意：雖然[堪察加](https://goo.gl/maps/vbKvMrHXtE7anj636)嚴格來說有一輛銀色車（配備 B 型天線），但它通常看起來是白色的，且屬於黑白車輛特徵的少數例外之一。

text: In Generation 4 coverage, **significant snow on the ground** is most commonly seen in Saratov Oblast and Eastern Voronezh Oblast.
text_zh: 在相機世代 4 街景中，**地面上有明顯積雪**的情況最常出現在薩拉托夫州和沃羅涅日州東部。

text: Stripy gas and water poles reminiscent of snow poles can often be found next to the road.
NOTE: Dozens of poles of various utilities all over Europe use stripy patterns. Consider the location of the pole, as well as other clues before making a guess.
text_zh: 道路旁經常可以找到讓人聯想到雪桿的有條紋瓦斯桿和水管桿。
注意：歐洲各地許多不同公用事業的電線桿都使用條紋圖案。在進行猜測之前，請考慮電線桿的位置以及其他線索。

text: Yellow snow poles with one or two reflectors are unique to Asturias. They are usually found in the south of the region.
text_zh: 帶有一或兩個反光板的黃色雪桿是阿斯圖里亞斯特有的。牠們通常出現在該地區的南部。

text: **Blue and yellow snow poles** are unique to Andalusia.
text_zh: **藍黃相間的雪桿**是安達魯西亞特有的。

text: Snow poles are typically **orange,** with a tall white reflector slightly above the middle of the pole. Some poles have a [second, thinner reflector](https://goo.gl/maps/p7anmAqGD4d4cWpU8) above the normal one.

NOTE: Finland and Norway both have similar orange snow poles. The reflector on [Finnish poles](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kY4315w9yyRt687A7) is usually much thinner and very close to the top. Norwegian poles typically have either [one](https://maps.app.goo.gl/rLTuiYPRgLYJeuUp7) or [two](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dBmWqWTEEVdaS6A17) slightly thinner reflectors, with one commonly being very close to the [middle](https://www.google.com/maps/@69.2671629,20.5483337,3a,15y,97.03h,80.51t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sjcbu5SMECpmICprrldDFEQ!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3Djcbu5SMECpmICprrldDFEQ%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D26.576565%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i16384!8i8192).
text_zh: 雪桿通常是**橘色**的，在桿子中段上方有一片高大的白色反光片。有些雪桿在正常反光片的上方還有[第二個較細的反光片](https://goo.gl/maps/p7anmAqGD4d4cWpU8)。

註：芬蘭和挪威都有類似的橘色雪桿。[芬蘭雪桿](https://maps.app.goo.gl/kY4315w9yyRt687A7)上的反光條通常細得多，且非常靠近頂端。挪威雪桿通常有一條或[兩條](https://maps.app.goo.gl/rLTuiYPRgLYJeuUp7)較細的反光條（[單條](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dBmWqWTEEVdaS6A17)的情況也很常見），其中一條通常非常靠近[中間](https://www.google.com/maps/@69.2671629,20.5483337,3a,15y,97.03h,80.51t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1sjcbu5SMECpmICprrldDFEQ!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3Djcbu5SMECpmICprrldDFEQ%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D26.576565%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i16384!8i8192)。

text: **Green snow poles** can occasionally be found in the area surrounding Umeå.
text_zh: 于默奧（Umeå）周邊地區偶爾可以找到**綠色雪桿**。

text: If you are in a mountainous area with orange snow poles that have **two wide reflectors close together**, you are very likely to be near the Norwegian border on, or close to road E12.
text_zh: 如果你身處山區，且橙色雪樁上有**兩個靠得很近的寬反光片**，你非常有可能靠近挪威邊境，或位於 E10 道路附近。

text: The stretch of road 95 closest to the Norwegian border can be recognized by a large number of **yellow snow poles**, all having two white reflectors. The coverage can be either Generation 2 in autumn or winter, or snowy Generation 4.
text_zh: 靠近挪威邊境的 95 號公路路段可以透過大量的**黃色雪樁**來識別，所有雪樁都有兩個白色反光片。街景覆蓋可能是秋季或冬季的 Generation 2，或者是積雪的 Generation 4。

text: If you see a **mixture** of orange and yellow snow poles in a mountainous area, you should be on road E10 close to the Norwegian border.
text_zh: 如果你在山區看到橙色和黃色雪樁的**混合**，你應該是在靠近挪威邊境的 E10 公路上。

text: Snow poles usually feature a colour sequence of black-orange-black-white from top to bottom, with small red reflectors.
text_zh: 雪桿通常從上到下呈現黑-橘-黑-白的顏色順序，並附有小型的紅色反光片。

text: The area stretching from the Canadian border to Northern New Mexico is home to the Rocky Mountains. These jagged, rocky formations often feature many **pine trees** and **visible snow** all year round at the highest peaks. Some areas of the Rocky Mountain Range are noticeably [dry](https://goo.gl/maps/cKv83UNDc6w9dqgK8), with few trees.
text_zh: 從加拿大邊境延伸至新墨西哥州北部的區域是洛磯山脈（Rocky Mountains）的所在地。這些鋸齒狀的岩石地形在最高峰通常有許多**松樹**，且全年都有**清晰可見的積雪**。洛磯山脈的某些地區明顯[乾燥](https://goo.gl/maps/cKv83UNDc6w9dqgK8)，且樹木稀少。

text: The Great Basin, centred around Nevada, can be recognized by the tall, sometimes [snow-capped](https://goo.gl/maps/NXgQnbWsKqmY3ybZ7) mountains in the background. There are dry, but grassy, and slightly **shrubby plains** leading up to the mountains.

The tallest mountains are in Nevada, Utah and California. More [gradual, rocky hills](https://goo.gl/maps/c9o9o95e3rQdr5k57) can be seen in Oregon, and [greener mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/s3pg7tQgwLH5oLg18) can be seen in Idaho and central Utah.
Keep in mind that there are exceptions, so make sure to look out for other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 以內華達州為中心的大盆地，其特徵是背景中高聳且有時[覆雪](https://goo.gl/maps/NXgQnbWsKqmY3ybZ7)的山脈。通往山脈的平原乾燥但長滿青草，且略帶**灌木叢生**。
最高聳的山脈位於內華達州、猶他州和加州。在奧勒岡州可以看到較為[平緩的岩石山丘](https://goo.gl/maps/c9o9o95e3rQdr5k57)，而在愛達荷州和猶他州中部則可以看到[較為翠綠的山脈](https://goo.gl/maps/s3pg7tQgwLH5oLg18)。
請記住凡事都有例外，因此在猜測之前務必留意其他線索。

text: Houses and commercial buildings in the interior Western US are often made of lots of **dark wooden boards and timbers**. Buildings at high elevations also commonly have [metal roofs](https://goo.gl/maps/cKmgYwdVFZv6WfTf9), to avoid snow build-up.
text_zh: 美國西部內陸的房屋和商業建築通常由大量**深色木板和木材**建成。高海拔地區的建築也普遍採用[金屬屋頂](https://goo.gl/maps/cKmgYwdVFZv6WfTf9)，以避免積雪。

text: On a lot of the Alaskan coverage you will be able to see tall, **snow covered mountains**.
text_zh: 在許多阿拉斯加的街景覆蓋中，你會看到高聳的**白雪覆蓋山脈**。

text: The North end of the Dalton Highway features a **flat** and **snowy landscape** and an overcast sky. A [small ridge](https://goo.gl/maps/fNWJxvvpz1Jzwjs89) of hills can be seen to the west of the highway in certain spots.
text_zh: 道爾頓公路的北端特徵是**平坦**的**雪景**和陰沉的天空。在某些地點，可以在公路西側看到[一條小山脊](https://goo.gl/maps/fNWJxvvpz1Jzwjs89)。

text: Andorra has a lot of Generation 2 **snow trekkers**, especially on ski resorts.
NOTE: Other countries have snow trekkers as well, but Andorra has the highest amount for its size.
text_zh: 安道爾有許多第二代**雪地徒步拍攝車**，尤其是在滑雪場。
注意：其他國家也有雪地徒步拍攝車，但安道爾相對其面積而言數量最多。

text: Most of Antarctica is covered in **snow and ice**.
text_zh: 南極洲大部分地區被**冰雪**覆蓋。

text: Danco Island can be recognised by the **beautiful sunset coverage** over a snowy fjord.
text_zh: 丹科島的特徵是白雪覆蓋的峽灣上，有**美麗的日落街景覆蓋**。

text: Petermann Island can be recognized by the layer of snow with patches of **exposed rocks**, and the overexposed camera.
text_zh: 彼得曼島的特徵是積雪層中夾雜著**露出地表的岩石**區塊，以及過度曝光的相機。

text: A **vast, snowy landscape **with spread out hills can be seen south of McMurdo station.
text_zh: 在麥克默多站的南方，可以看到一片 **廣闊的雪景**，其中散佈著零星的山丘。

text: This **snow coverage** is found on the eastern RP25 in eastern Santa Cruz.
text_zh: 這種**雪覆蓋**出現在聖克魯斯省東部的 RP25 東段。

text: **Melting** **snow coverage** is seen on the eastern RN293 close to the Chilean border in southwestern Santa Cruz.
text_zh: 在聖克魯斯省西南部的 RN293 東段，靠近智利邊境處可見**融化**的**雪覆蓋**。

text: These snowy mountains to the north can only be found in **Ushuaia**.
NOTE: Ushuaia is the southernmost city of Argentina and the province capital of Tierra del Fuego.
text_zh: 北方的這些雪山只出現在**烏斯懷亞**。
備註：烏斯懷亞是阿根廷最南端的城市，也是火地島省的省會。

text: Ruta 1 between Machacamarca and Guindal runs through an arid landscape where you will often see patches of **snow on the hilltops**, and sometimes even [next to the road](https://goo.gl/maps/G87Gugfru1v6zi1D8). Weather conditions range from **cloudy to fully overcast**, lending this coverage a gloomy look.
The aforementioned road can be regionguessed even more precisely. See the next two tips.
text_zh: Machacamarca 和 Guindal 之間的 Ruta 1 穿過乾旱的景觀，你經常會看到**山頂上有積雪**，有時甚至會出現[在路邊](https://goo.gl/maps/G87Gugfru1v6zi1D8)。天氣狀況介於**多雲到陰天**之間，賦予這段街景覆蓋一種陰沉的外觀。
上述道路可以進行更精確的區域猜測。請參閱接下來的兩個提示。

text: On the southwesternmost section of Ruta 4, you can usually see the **Nevado Sajama**, an isolated snow-capped volcano that is very distinct and unlike any other mountain in Bolivia.
When you see Sajama, you will always be south of Callapa and the Desaguadero River. However, you will not always be able to see it on this section of the road, as it is often hidden by hills.
NOTE: The only other place where you can see Nevado Sajama is coverage in the National Park, which is recognizable by its unique Google car.
text_zh: 在 Ruta 4 最西南端的路段上，你通常可以看到**薩哈馬火山**（Nevado Sajama），這是一座孤立的雪山火山，非常獨特且與玻利維亞的任何其他山脈都不同。
當你看見薩哈馬火山時，你一定位於 Callapa 和德薩瓜德羅河以南。然而，你在這段道路上並不總能看到它，因為它經常被丘陵遮擋。
註：唯一能看到薩哈馬火山的其他地方是國家公園內的街景覆蓋，該處可透過其獨特的 Google 車來辨識。

text: The **Trans-Labrador Highway** (road numbers 500 and 510) is a recognizable road, covered by Generation 4, mostly during sunny weather conditions. Thin pine** **trees line the side of the road, and it has a remote, cold, and northern feel. On many parts of the road, the sun is low in the sky. In addition, when the car drives past the city of **Happy Valley-Goose Bay**, it is common to see [snow on the ground](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oGGyzG5H1sVvQot78).
text_zh: **橫拉布拉多公路**（500 號與 510 號公路）是一條特徵鮮明的道路，由 Generation 4 拍攝，大多處於晴朗天氣。道路兩側排列著纖細的松** **樹，帶有一種偏遠、寒冷且偏北的感覺。在該公路的許多路段，太陽仰角都很低。此外，當車輛開過**歡喜谷-鵝灣**市時，常見到[地面上有積雪](https://maps.app.goo.gl/oGGyzG5H1sVvQot78)。

text: QC-167 and QC-113 are covered in Gen 3 and identifiable for their **overcast autumn** coverage, often with **snow** on the ground. In addition, a [smudge](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8TUyRYbPxNvXMX2m9) can be seen on this road.
text_zh: QC-167 與 QC-113 由 Gen 3 覆蓋，其特徵是**陰天的秋季**街景覆蓋，地面上常有**積雪**。此外，這條路上還可以看到[鏡頭污漬](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8TUyRYbPxNvXMX2m9)。

text: Sanikiluaq is a remote town situated **in Hudson Bay**. This snowy town was covered by a snowmobile whose driver wore a dark **brown **coat.
NOTE: Snowmobile coverage can be found [outside](https://goo.gl/maps/7xhV916CkhjwrEhU8) the town on the ice-covered sea, where the driver is **not **visible.
text_zh: 薩尼基盧阿克（Sanikiluaq）是位於**哈德遜灣**（Hudson Bay）中的偏遠城鎮。這個雪景城鎮是由一台雪上摩托車拍攝的，駕駛穿著深**棕**色外套。
注意：在冰封的海面上，也就是城鎮[外圍](https://goo.gl/maps/7xhV916CkhjwrEhU8)，可以找到雪上摩托車街景，在那裡**看不到**駕駛。

text: The northern town of Resolute can be recognized by the **barren **landscape with visible **patches of snow**.
text_zh: 北方城鎮雷索盧特可以透過**荒涼的**景觀與隨處可見的**殘雪**來辨識。

text: Part of Ruta 41 is located in a valley, with **snowy** mountains seen in the distance. Many trees and vineyards can commonly be seen toward the west. Triple yellow lines can also be seen from [this point](https://goo.gl/maps/C4gxEFDpZX1Uz6er5).
text_zh: 41 號公路（Ruta 41）的一部分位於山谷中，遠處可以看到**積雪的**山脈。向西常可見到許多樹木和葡萄園。從 [這個點](https://goo.gl/maps/C4gxEFDpZX1Uz6er5) 還可以看到三黃線。

text: A distinct landscape consisting of a line of snow-capped mountains with two other isolated, symmetrical **snow-capped volcanoes** are seen in Lauca National Park. Most of the roads are newly paved and have a smooth, dark look.
text_zh: 勞卡國家公園（Lauca National Park）中可以看到一條獨特的景觀，由一排覆雪的山脈以及另外兩座孤立、對稱的**覆雪火山**組成。大部分道路都是新鋪設的，具有平坦、深色的外觀。

text: Alto Loa National Reserve can be recognized by the vast, open landscape, followed by **salt pans** leading up to snow-capped **volcanoes**. The road running through the reserve is paved.
text_zh: 阿爾托洛阿國家保護區（Alto Loa National Reserve）可以透過廣闊開闊的景觀來辨認，接著是通往**火山**的**鹽灘**。貫穿保護區的道路是鋪裝道路。

text: In the west, Nevado Tres Cruces National Park can be recognized by the vast, open landscape, followed by **salt pans** leading up to a line of mountains. The sand has a **reddish **tint.
In the east, the Google Car drives up a mountain pass with views of lightly snow-capped volcanoes and **snow **on the side of the road. The roads in the National Park are paved.
text_zh: 在西部，內瓦多特雷斯克魯塞斯國家公園（Nevado Tres Cruces National Park）可以透過廣闊開闊的景觀來辨認，接著是通往一排山脈的**鹽灘**。沙子帶有**紅色**調。
在東部，Google 車行駛在一個山隘上，可以看到微帶積雪的火山以及路邊的**雪**。國家公園內的道路都是鋪裝道路。

text: Villa O’Higgins can be recognized by the large **mountains** located immediately to the east. To the west, [snow-capped mountains](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QGUzYaHWvb8PphP99) are seen in the distance. Street signs, fences and many other structures throughout the village are made of orange-stained wood.
text_zh: 維拉奧伊金斯（Villa O’Higgins）可以透過位於正東方的大型**山脈**來辨認。向西望去，遠處可以看到 [覆雪山脈](https://maps.app.goo.gl/QGUzYaHWvb8PphP99)。村莊各處的街道標誌、柵欄和許多其他結構都是由染成橘色的木頭製成的。

text: The Atacama Large Millimetre Array can be recognized by the many radio telescopes in a barren, snowy environment.
text_zh: 阿他加馬大型毫米波陣列望遠鏡可以透過荒涼、有雪的環境中的許多電波望遠鏡來識別。

text: **Snow coverage** can be found on a few roads southeast of the Cyprus island label, near the Holy Monastery of Panagia Machaira.
text_zh: 在賽普勒斯島標籤東南方、帕納吉亞馬海拉修道院（Holy Monastery of Panagia Machaira）附近的一些道路上，可以找到**雪景覆蓋**。

text: Much of Czech Generation 3 coverage was taken **during winter**, resulting in very grey, and occasionally snowy, coverage.
NOTE: This is not common in Slovakia.
text_zh: 捷克大部分的相機世代 3 街景覆蓋都是**在冬天**拍攝的，因此畫面非常灰暗，偶爾還帶有積雪。
注意：這在斯洛伐克並不常見。

text: There are two distinct **pyramid-shaped mountains** to the south of the trekker on Klakkur, with a very thin layer of snow on top.
text_zh: 克拉克（Klakkur）徒步拍攝的南側有兩座形狀明顯的**金字塔形山脈**，山頂覆蓋著薄薄的雪。

text: The trekker by Gjógv features a view of the **village to the south** with snow covered mountains in the background.
text_zh: 焦格夫（Gjógv）旁的徒步拍攝可以看到**南側村莊**的景色，背景則是覆雪的山脈。

text: **Generation 3 snow coverage **is only found in far northwestern Lapland.
NOTE: Be careful: this tip is specifically about regular Generation 3 coverage. Generation 2, 4, and trekker snow coverage can be found elsewhere.
text_zh: **第 3 代雪地覆蓋**僅見於拉普蘭的最西北端。
註記：請注意：這項提示專門針對一般的第三代街景。第二代、第四代和徒步拍攝雪景可以在其他地方找到。

text: The Greenlandic landscape is very barren, with **no trees or taller vegetation **and often featuring snow. Mountains and hills are common, with very limited flat areas. On top of that, almost all coverage was taken in coastal areas, so fjords and visible coastlines are very common.
text_zh: 格陵蘭的景觀非常荒涼，**沒有樹木或高大植被**，且經常有雪。山脈和小山很常見，平坦地區非常有限。除此之外，幾乎所有的街景覆蓋都是在沿海地區拍攝的，因此峽灣和清晰可見的海岸線非常普遍。

text: The most noticeable feature of the coverage in Aasiaat is the windshield with a **shiny red, white and black **reflection. The large, round side mirrors can also be used to identify the town. The coverage is very sunny and has thick, thawing snow along most of the roads.
text_zh: 阿西亚特街景最明顯的特徵是擋風玻璃上有**閃亮的紅、白、黑**反光。大型的圓形側視鏡也可以用來辨識這個城鎮。此處街景非常晴朗，且大部分道路旁都有厚重、正在融化的積雪。

text: The coverage in Maniitsoq was taken by a **tractor**, making it very recognizable. The coverage is overcast and fairly snowy.
text_zh: Maniitsoq 的街景覆蓋是由**曳引機**所拍攝，非常好認。街景覆蓋是陰天且有相當多的積雪。

text: The coverage in and around Igaliku is most easily recognized by the wide, **snow-covered mountain range** to the northeast which looks very bright due to the setting sun. The green ATV, while not entirely unique on its own, can also be a useful hint.
text_zh: Igaliku 及其周邊的街景覆蓋最容易透過東北方寬闊、**覆雪的山脈**來辨識，在落日餘暉下顯得非常明亮。綠色的 ATV 雖然本身並非完全獨一無二，但也是一個很有用的線索。

text: The coverage connecting Sisimiut and Kangerlussuaq is easily recognized by the **thick layer of snow** on and around the road. The sun sets along the road, making the western parts very bright and the eastern parts very dark.
text_zh: 連接 Sisimiut 與 Kangerlussuaq 的街景覆蓋很容易透過道路上及周邊的**厚重積雪**來辨識。太陽沿著道路西落，使得西部非常明亮而東部非常黑暗。

text: Kangaatsiaq has a large amount of **thawing snow** on the side of the roads. The sun is setting and there is a large body of water to the west.
text_zh: Kangaatsiaq 的道路兩旁有大量的**融雪**。太陽正在西下，西方有一大片水域。

text: To the southwest of Qaanaaq, you can see icebergs in a large body of water, and a wide mountain range on the other side, where the snow is **bright white** as it reflects the sunlight through the thick clouds.
text_zh: 在 Qaanaaq 的西南方，你可以看到大片水域中的冰山，以及對岸寬闊的山脈，由於陽光透過厚雲反射，那裡的雪呈現**亮白色**。

text: A **red and black ATV **can be found in and around the village of Kapisillit, northeast of Nuuk. Many mountains in the distance are covered in a layer of snow.
text_zh: 在努克東北方的 Kapisillit 村莊內及周邊可以找到一台**紅黑相間的 ATV**。遠處許多山峰都覆蓋著一層雪。

text: On a small bit of coverage east of Nuuk you can see a large number of sharp mountains, **powdered in snow**. The coverage is somewhat dark due to the thick clouds and the sun being hidden behind the mountains.
text_zh: 在努克東側的一小段街景覆蓋中，你可以看到大量覆蓋著**薄雪**的尖峭山峰。由於厚雲以及太陽被群山遮蔽，街景覆蓋顯得有些昏暗。

text: The **wide valley** around Eiðar is slightly hilly and agricultural, with tall, **snowy peaks visible in the distance** on either side, to the east and northwest, respectively.
text_zh: 埃伊爾斯塔濟周圍的**寬闊山谷**略帶丘陵且屬於農業區，東西兩側的**遠處可見高聳的雪峰**。

text: The Mechuka valley is the only place in Northeast India where snowy mountains are visible. The valley contains brownish grass and a plethora of Bhutan white pine. [North of Mechuka](https://www.google.com/maps/@28.6320523,94.0662987,3a,49y,194.26h,92.18t,359.98r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1smCvraPHUR1hld15MPCcP1Q!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) the coverage gradually becomes overcast and somewhat dark.
text_zh: 梅楚卡山谷是印度東北部唯一能看到雪山的地方。山谷裡有褐色的草和大量的不丹白松。[梅楚卡以北](https://www.google.com/maps/@28.6320523,94.0662987,3a,49y,194.26h,92.18t,359.98r/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1smCvraPHUR1hld15MPCcP1Q!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)的街景覆蓋逐漸變得陰暗且有些昏暗。

text: [Chaukhamba](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chaukhamba), located near the town of Ukhimath, is a mountain massif covered in snow which can be recognised by its **three distinct peaks**, with the centre peak being the tallest.
text_zh: 位於烏基馬特鎮附近的[喬卡姆巴峰](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chaukhamba)是一座覆蓋著積雪的山峰群，其特徵是擁有**三個明顯的峰頂**，其中中央峰最高。

text: This infrastructural **arrow** informs drivers of where the shoulder line is when under snow, and is located almost exclusively in **Hokkaido**.
NOTE: While much more rare, other variations can be found here:
- This arrow, found in the Aomori prefecture (or more rarely Hokkaido), has distinct [silver bolts](https://goo.gl/maps/Wzi6Ck3BdAB4sY5bA) around the border.
- This variation, found in the Gifu prefecture, is [long and thin](https://goo.gl/maps/fW4rPrBMBpjc1jvw6).
- This alternate [yellow and black](https://goo.gl/maps/JkwqhdWszVzfhDEm6) design can often be found on the northern part of National Highway 275 in Hokkaido.
- This [yellow and green](https://goo.gl/maps/coTFwyXtYaPsfbku6) arrow is found southwest of Sapporo.
- This [yellow and black](https://goo.gl/maps/rsRHBpDVhF9uaHSv9) arrow can be found on Hokkaido.
text_zh: 這種**箭頭指示板**用來在積雪時告訴駕駛路肩的位置，幾乎只出現在**北海道**。
註：其他變體罕見得多，分布如下：
- 青森縣（偶爾北海道）的版本，邊框周圍有明顯的[銀色螺栓](https://goo.gl/maps/Wzi6Ck3BdAB4sY5bA)。
- 岐阜縣的版本[細長](https://goo.gl/maps/fW4rPrBMBpjc1jvw6)。
- 這種[黃黑](https://goo.gl/maps/JkwqhdWszVzfhDEm6)配色常見於北海道國道 275 號的北段。
- 這種[黃綠](https://goo.gl/maps/coTFwyXtYaPsfbku6)箭頭出現在札幌西南方。
- 這種[黃黑](https://goo.gl/maps/rsRHBpDVhF9uaHSv9)箭頭在北海道找得到。

text: Snow prevention roads, known as ‘Shosetsu’, are found mainly in northwest coastal prefectures. They appear as **tiny circles **in the pavement, and spray warm underground water to clear snow.
text_zh: 稱為「消雪」的融雪路面主要分布在西北沿海各縣。外觀是路面上的**細小圓孔**，會噴出溫熱地下水來融雪。

text: The further you are **north**, roofs generally transition from tiled to level or flat sloped in order to compensate for heavy snowfall. Northern houses often have **ladders** attached to the side, giving roof access to clear snow.
NOTE: In addition to north to south, high-elevation mountainous regions or high snowfall areas often use such roofs, even in more central or southern prefectures.
text_zh: 越往**北**，屋頂會從瓦片逐漸轉為平緩或平坦的形式，以因應大雪。北部住宅側面常裝有**梯子**，方便上屋頂剷雪。
註：除了南北差異之外，高海拔山區或多雪地帶也常用這種屋頂，即使位在中部或南部各縣。

text: Hokkaido has very **limited** winter and snow coverage. Unless you are certain, it is often better not to guess this prefecture. Though, if you do find yourself in Hokkaido, these regions are most likely. Other low amounts of miscellaneous coverage is primarily in the southern half of the island.
text_zh: 北海道的冬季與積雪街景**極為有限**。除非很有把握，否則通常不建議猜這裡。真的判斷是北海道時，圖上這幾個地區的機率最高，其餘零星覆蓋主要集中在島嶼南半部。

text: **Mount Fuji** is the tallest mountain in Japan, with a gradual incline and often snowy summit.
Depending on the elevation, it can be seen from far away. This can create some excellent region guesses, especially if you account for direction and distance.
text_zh: **富士山**是日本最高峰，山勢坡度平緩，山頂經常積雪。
由於海拔夠高，遠距離也看得到。若能一併判斷方位與距離，往往可以推出相當精準的位置。

text: **Tall mountains**, which are often **snow-capped**, can be seen in southeastern Kazakhstan.
text_zh: 哈薩克東南部可以看到**高山**，且通常**山頂覆雪**。

text: **Snow **coverage can be found in **southeastern **Kazakhstan, especially east of Almaty.
text_zh: 哈薩克**東南部**可以找到**雪地**覆蓋，特別是在阿拉木圖以東地區。

text: In southern Almaty City, there is **snow** coverage **in the mountains**.
text_zh: 在阿爾馬提市南部，**山區**有**雪**景覆蓋。

text: The Altyn Emel National Park is a barren grassland with snowy mountains in all directions. Some parts are [very snowy](https://goo.gl/maps/7K5s7XqLSKzpMLvEA). And in the eastern section, there is a small [curvy mountain pass](https://goo.gl/maps/8rJPLHV5Zs7DxQC87).
text_zh: 阿爾廷埃梅爾國家公園是一片貧瘠的草原，四周環繞著雪山。某些部分[非常雪白](https://goo.gl/maps/7K5s7XqLSKzpMLvEA)。而在東部路段，有一個小型[蜿蜒山隘](https://goo.gl/maps/8rJPLHV5Zs7DxQC87)。

text: All of Kyrgyzstan was covered during the **winter months**, so many of the trees will lack leaves, the landscape will be quite drab, and you can see snow in many parts of Kyrgyzstan.
text_zh: 整個吉爾吉斯斯坦的街景都是在**冬季**拍攝的，所以許多樹木沒有葉子、景觀相當枯黃，且在吉爾吉斯斯坦的許多地方都可以看到雪。

text: These northern roads have a considerable amount of **snow**, and the sky is generally bright.
The individual sections of these roads are discussed in more detail in step 3.
NOTE: There is also snow coverage in the south. However, you can use the mirror to distinguish these roads.
text_zh: 這些北部道路有相當多的**雪**，且天空通常很明亮。
這些道路的各個路段將在步驟 3 中進行更詳細的討論。
注意：南部也有雪景覆蓋。不過，你可以利用鏡像來區分這些道路。

text: You can find **urban snow coverage** in this region of Bishkek.
text_zh: 你可以在比許凱克的這個區域找到**市區雪景覆蓋**。

text: The coverage south of Bishkek is generally a bit hilly, and you will see the **snowy Tian Shan mountains** to the south. And as Bishkek has the most polluted air of any city, there will usually be visible **smog** to the north.
text_zh: 比許凱克南方的街景通常有點丘陵起伏，你往南會看到**多雪的天山山脈**。由於比許凱克是空氣汙染最嚴重的城市，北方通常會看到明顯的**霧霾**。

text: Manas (Previously Jalal-Abad) is the third-biggest city in Kyrgyzstan. Like Osh, its coverage has the **southern mirror**.
You can recognise it from the **extremely overcast coverage**, with no gaps in the clouds. This allows you to easily distinguish it from Osh, which has better weather.
To the east, you can see this [slightly snowy hill](https://goo.gl/maps/ZUZ7tn1pTEmFmeF3A).
text_zh: 馬納斯（舊稱賈拉拉巴德）是吉爾吉斯第三大城市。跟奧什一樣，它的街景覆蓋具有**南部鏡像**。
你可以從**極度陰天且雲層無縫隙的街景**認出它。這讓你能輕鬆將它與天氣較好的奧什區分開來。
向東看，你可以看到這個[微雪的小山丘](https://goo.gl/maps/ZUZ7tn1pTEmFmeF3A)。

text: Arslanbob is a **snowy** town north of Manas (Previously Jalal-Abad), with hills and mountains all around. As the town is located in the mountains, you can see a lot of **elevation change** inside the town.
NOTE: The town also features the southern mirror.
text_zh: 阿爾斯朗博布（Arslanbob）是馬納斯（舊稱賈拉拉巴德）以北的一個**多雪**城鎮，四周環繞著山丘與山脈。由於該城鎮位於山區，你可以在鎮內看到許多**高低起伏**。
注意：該城鎮同樣具有南部鏡像。

text: Uzgen is a **slightly snowy** town between Osh and Manas (Previously Jalal-Abad), which features **overcast** coverage.
NOTE: The town also features the southern mirror.
text_zh: 烏茲根（Uzgen）是奧什與馬納斯（舊稱賈拉拉巴德）之間的一個**微雪**城鎮，其街景為**陰天**。
注意：該城鎮同樣具有南部鏡像。

text: Karakol is a city located between snow capped mountains to the north and south. The coverage in the city is **sunny**, and you can see **melting snow** on the ground.
text_zh: 卡拉科爾（Karakol）是一座位於南北白雪皚皚山脈之間的城市。市區的街景是**晴天**，你可以在地面上看到**融雪**。

text: Naryn features a steep **orange ridge** to the north, and big snow capped mountains to the south.
text_zh: 納倫（Naryn）的特徵是北側有一道陡峭的**橘色山脊**，南側則是巨大的雪山。

text: On this long stretch of road, you will see plenty of **snow** all around you, except on the road. The Landscape is generally hilly, except the northeastern and southwestern parts, which are in the mountains.
NOTE: Most of this section features the Black Dot Mirror.
text_zh: 在這段漫長的道路上，除了路面之外，你會看到周圍全是**雪**。地貌大體上是丘陵起伏，除了位於山區的東北部和西南部。
注意：這段路的大部分路段具有黑點鏡像。

text: This section of road goes through mountains that have **rocky cliffs**. These mountains are a habitat for lots of [spruce trees](https://goo.gl/maps/6ykqFWDntTbrPQnX6) that grow on the cliff sides. A more diverse selection of trees grows next to the river that follows the road. You can see that [some mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/ZYdKwBNtUvT3WQH8A) still have snow on the peaks. Most [signposts](https://goo.gl/maps/bRKCMi9bDmj5YCQV6) along the road are coloured blue.
NOTE: The southern section of the road features more rocky cliffs that cannot sustain any trees.
text_zh: 這段路穿過擁有**岩石懸崖**的山區。這些山脈是許多生長在懸崖邊的[雲杉樹](https://goo.gl/maps/6ykqFWDntTbrPQnX6)的棲息地。順著道路流淌的河流旁生長著更多樣化的樹木。你可以看到[有些山峰](https://goo.gl/maps/ZYdKwBNtUvT3WQH8A)頂端仍有積雪。沿路的 plupart [路標](https://goo.gl/maps/bRKCMi9bDmj5YCQV6)都是藍色的。
注意：該道路的南部路段有更多無法支撐任何樹木生長的陡峭岩壁。

text: In the south, this stretch of road northwest of Uzgen is characterised by **overcast** coverage and lots of **snow**.
NOTE: This section of road features the Southern Mirror.
text_zh: 在南部，烏茲根西北側的這段道路特徵是**陰天**街景以及大量的**雪**。
注意：這段路段具有南部鏡像。

text: Further up the road, you enter a **dry valley** with mountains flanking both sides. There is barely any vegetation - just some shrubs close to the ground. The river next to the road brings some more [greenery](https://goo.gl/maps/QHRbRNePyag8rCWZ7) to the area. In the southern half of this section, you can see this [slightly snowy ridge](https://goo.gl/maps/EXF4khfG7pRPC3hY6) to the north.
text_zh: 順著路往前，你進入了一個兩側環繞著山脈的**乾燥山谷**。這裡幾乎沒有植被——只有一些靠近地面的灌木。道路旁的小河為該地區帶來了更多[綠意](https://goo.gl/maps/QHRbRNePyag8rCWZ7)。在這段路的南半部，你可以看到北側有這個[微雪的山脊](https://goo.gl/maps/EXF4khfG7pRPC3hY6)。

text: Once you get out of the valley, you will notice this area is **more vegetated**, has **more buildings**, and more animals on the now grassy fields. The landscape is still hilly, with bigger mountains to the north, south, and west. The southern mountains are especially distinct, with them being covered in snow. The hills immediately north of Naryn can get very dry, but look out for [snow](https://goo.gl/maps/E8fD9vJwmhoBrUfNA) that you can see in the shade.
text_zh: 一旦你走出了山谷，你會注意到這裡**植被更多**、**建築物更多**，且在現在長滿青草的原野上有更多動物。地貌依舊是丘陵起伏，北側、南側和西側都有更大的山脈。南側的山脈特別顯眼，上面覆蓋著白雪。納倫正北方的山丘會非常乾燥，但請留意你在陰影處可以看到的[雪](https://goo.gl/maps/E8fD9vJwmhoBrUfNA)。

text: The mountains and hills south of Naryn have a unique combination of **snow** and **red soil** that make them very distinct.
text_zh: 納倫以南的山脈和山丘擁有**雪**與**紅土**的獨特組合，使其非常顯眼。

text: The vertical stretch of road north of Karakol is mostly flanked by tall **tree rows** on either side. There are also tall **snowy mountains** to the north and south.
NOTE: The weather changes [here](https://goo.gl/maps/KRut2ZyU5NqN4kSh9), around the midpoint of the road.
text_zh: 卡拉科爾以北的垂直路段兩旁大多有高大的**樹排**夾道。北部和南部也有高大的**雪山**。
注意：天氣在道路中點附近的[這裡](https://goo.gl/maps/KRut2ZyU5NqN4kSh9)發生了變化。

text: This section of EM-17 is **very snowy**. The hills and mountains around the road are almost fully covered in snow. Unlike the other snowy roads, this road is often covered in **uncleared slush** or melted snow.
NOTE: This section of road features the Black Dot Mirror.
text_zh: EM-17 的這段路**非常多雪**。道路周圍的山丘和山脈幾乎完全被雪覆蓋。與其他多雪的道路不同，這條路經常覆蓋著**未清除的半融雪**或融雪。
注意：這段路段具有黑點鏡像。

text: Going further west, only the hills to the **south** will have **snow** on them. The landscape is generally dry, with hills to the north and south of the road.
Most of this section features the Black Dot Mirror.
text_zh: 繼續向西走，只有**南側**的山丘上會有**雪**。地貌大致乾燥，道路南北兩側都有山丘。
這段路的大部分路段具有黑點鏡像。

text: The road going east of Naryn is also in the Naryn Valley. Here you will also see hills close to the road in the south, and then further away to the north. The plains north of the road are however smaller. This side is also more **built up**, except the road, which is **unpaved** at certain parts. Here, the hills south also have small amounts of snow on them.
text_zh: 納倫以東的道路同樣位於納倫河谷。在這裡，你也會看到南側有緊鄰道路的山丘，北側的山丘則距離較遠。不過，道路北側的平原較小。這一側的**開發程度也較高**，除了某些路段**未鋪面**之外。在這裡，南側的山丘上也帶有少量的雪。

text: Song-Kul is the second major lake in Kyrgyzstan. The surrounding area features **dry rolling hills**, with [patches of snow](https://goo.gl/maps/RsdaJzrygRHw2diXA). The only covered road is made of [gravel](https://goo.gl/maps/Esedn3HTkCWHPvU66).
text_zh: 宋湖是吉爾吉斯的第二大湖泊。周邊地區的特徵是**乾燥的起伏丘陵**，並帶有[零星雪塊](https://goo.gl/maps/RsdaJzrygRHw2diXA)。唯一有街景覆蓋的道路是由[碎石](https://goo.gl/maps/Esedn3HTkCWHPvU66)鋪成的。

text: The road in the mountains south of Song-Kul is the only unpaved road this **high up** in the mountains. You can see the clouds below you, down in the valleys below. The mountains have rugged peaks, and snowy cliff sides. Many of the mountains also have **spruce trees** growing on them.
text_zh: 宋湖以南山區的道路是山區中海拔**這麼高**的唯一未鋪面道路。你可以看到下方的雲朵在下方的山谷中。山脈擁有崎嶇的山峰和覆蓋著雪的懸崖邊。許多山脈上還生長著**雲杉樹**。

text: On this road, you should be able to see the **Kara Darya river** to the east in the valley below the road. The region is generally hilly and green. To the north, you can see some [low-lying mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/fYZUkPu26QE6tfCQ9) in the distance, they have some snow on them. The hills east of the river have snow on the top as well.
NOTE: This section of road features the Southern Dirty Mirror.
text_zh: 在這條路上，你應該能夠看到道路下方山谷中東側的**卡拉達里亞河（Kara Darya river）**。該地區普遍多山且綠意盎然。向北看，你可以在遠處看到一些[低矮山脈](https://goo.gl/maps/fYZUkPu26QE6tfCQ9)，上面有一些雪。河流東側的山丘頂部也有雪。
注意：這段路段具有南部髒鏡像。

text: There will generally be some **snow** on the ground on this road. You will see more snow depending on how north you are. You will often see the massive [Gora Babash-Ata mountain](https://goo.gl/maps/kGtjN6oAmAbvkUze9) to the north.
NOTE: This section of road features the Southern Dirty Mirror.
text_zh: 這條路上的地面通常會有一些**雪**。你會根據自己有多靠北而看到更多雪。你經常會看到北側巨大的[巴巴什阿塔山（Gora Babash-Ata）](https://goo.gl/maps/kGtjN6oAmAbvkUze9)。
注意：這段路段具有南部髒鏡像。

text: This section near Arkit has a lot of **snow** everywhere and **low broad leafed trees** all around. This already unique landscape paired with the south to north driving direction makes it very easy to recognise.
text_zh: 阿爾基特附近的這段路到處都是**雪**，周圍環繞著**低矮的闊葉樹**。這種本就獨特的景觀搭配由南向北的行駛方向，使得這裡非常容易辨認。

text: This section of the M-010 is surrounded by beautiful **spruce covered snowy mountains**. Some snow has also gathered on the sides of the road.
text_zh: M-010的這段路被美麗的**雲杉覆蓋的雪山**環繞。路邊也積了一些雪。

text: There is another road with coverage to the east of the Chunkurchak road: it goes through a very **rocky valley**, with a variety of plants growing on the mountainsides, of which only some have small amounts of snow. You can also see some snow in the valley, and more so towards the south.
text_zh: 在春丘克道路的東側還有另一條有街景覆蓋的路：它穿過一個非常**岩石密布的山谷**，山坡上生長著各種植物，其中只有少數有少量的雪。你也可以在山谷中看到一些雪，越往南越多。

text: You can easily recognise this side road, labelled as A367 on the map, from the snow covered mountain ranges in **every** direction. The sun to the south is almost blinding.
NOTE: This section of road features the Black Dot Mirror.
text_zh: 你可以從**四面八方**被覆雪山脈環繞的特徵，輕鬆認出這條在地圖上標示為A367的小路。南邊的太陽幾乎令人目眩。
注意：這段路段具有黑點鏡像。

text: The road south of Jeti Oguz goes through a valley. The general landscape in this valley is **very green** by Kyrgyzstan standards, there are plenty of trees and bushes growing in the valley and on the hills. You can see small patches of snow still on the ground. From most of the valley, you can still see the [Tian Shan mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/n5nMitgC1Zx3N7H69) to the north, and other snowy mountains to the south. The valley also contains these [unique orange rock formations](https://goo.gl/maps/b1a7ct7RJ3iedLDPA).
text_zh: 傑提奧古茲（Jeti Oguz）南側的道路穿過一個山谷。以吉爾吉斯標準來看，這個山谷中的整體景觀**非常翠綠**，山谷中和山丘上生長著大量的樹木和灌木。你還可以看到地面上有一小塊一小塊的殘雪。從山谷的大部分地方，你仍然可以看到北邊的[天山山脈](https://goo.gl/maps/n5nMitgC1Zx3N7H69)，以及南邊的其他雪山。山谷中也包含這些[獨特的橙色岩石地形](https://goo.gl/maps/b1a7ct7RJ3iedLDPA)。

text: The road north of Grigorievka goes through a stunning river valley. This is one of the most unique roads in Kyrgyzstan. You can easily recognise it from the **spruce covered mountains** in this rocky valley. The lack of snow is also notable.

The [northern half](https://www.google.com/maps/@42.8331837,77.4143633,2a,90y,134.55h,91.08t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1s7LGOZHJ1Tx8HoLdqRrNNMA!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3D7LGOZHJ1Tx8HoLdqRrNNMA%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D36.16604%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) of this road is on an open rolling field with pine forests scattered around.
text_zh: 格里戈里耶夫卡（Grigorievka）北側的道路穿過一個令人驚嘆的河谷。這是吉爾吉斯最獨特的道路之一。你可以從這個岩石山谷中**雲杉覆蓋的山脈**輕易將其認出。沒有雪也是一個顯著特點。

這條路的[北半部](https://www.google.com/maps/@42.8331837,77.4143633,2a,90y,134.55h,91.08t/data=!3m7!1e1!3m5!1s7LGOZHJ1Tx8HoLdqRrNNMA!2e0!6shttps:%2F%2Fstreetviewpixels-pa.googleapis.com%2Fv1%2Fthumbnail%3Fpanoid%3D7LGOZHJ1Tx8HoLdqRrNNMA%26cb_client%3Dmaps_sv.tactile.gps%26w%3D203%26h%3D100%26yaw%3D36.16604%26pitch%3D0%26thumbfov%3D100!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)位於開闊的起伏原野上，周圍散落著松林。

text: There is a side road north of the Orto Tokoy Reservoir that has very broken coverage. This road is **well maintained**, and it passes through **dry mountains**. The only vegetation around is grass and shrubs. To the west, you can see this [mountain](https://goo.gl/maps/EYX6oJnUFHhxN89P8) which has little snow left. To the north, the [mountains](https://goo.gl/maps/NP7X99RuTAnMVSNu5) are dark, similar to silhouettes, and on the southern portion of the road, you will see the [reservoir](https://goo.gl/maps/tqBo8qMqdCXkZhjT9).
text_zh: 奧爾托托科伊水庫（Orto Tokoy Reservoir）北側有一條支路，其街景覆蓋非常破碎。這條路**維護良好**，它穿過**乾旱的山脈**。周圍唯一的植被是草和灌木。向西望去，你可以看到這座[山峰](https://goo.gl/maps/EYX6oJnUFHhxN89P8)，上面幾乎沒有殘雪。向北望去，[山脈](https://goo.gl/maps/NP7X99RuTAnMVSNu5)呈深色，類似剪影，而在道路的南部，你會看到[水庫](https://goo.gl/maps/tqBo8qMqdCXkZhjT9)。

text: This remote gravel road southwest of Naryn passes through a **dry and desolate valley**. Despite the river, there is nothing but some shrubs on the ground. Many of the mountains in the valley have steep, rocky cliff sides. You will also find snow here, but more so in the south.
text_zh: 納倫（Naryn）西南方這條偏遠的碎石路穿過一個**乾旱荒涼的山谷**。儘管有河流，但地面上除了幾叢灌木外什麼也沒有。山谷中的許多山脈都有陡峭的岩石懸崖面。你在這裡也會發現雪，但越往南越多。

text: Coverage where **snow **is visible on mountain tops, or on the ground, is found in the northeastern mountains, east of Tripoli.
text_zh: 山頂或地面上看得見**雪**的街景覆蓋，位於黎波里以東的東北部山脈。

text: **Snow **coverage is mostly found around Ulaanbaatar.
text_zh: **雪地**街景主要分佈在烏蘭巴托周圍。

text: The Mandalgovi Highway runs south of the capital and was covered during a blizzard, making it **extremely snowy and foggy.** It also has a deep blue tent, which is found along this entire road, and a flat landscape which can differentiate it from other snowy roads.
text_zh: 曼達勒戈壁公路（Mandalgovi Highway）位於首都南方，拍攝時正逢暴風雪，因此**極度雪霧迷漫**。這條路的沿線全段都有深藍色的帳篷，且地勢平坦，這點能與其他下雪的道路區分開來。

text: The Darkhan-Erdenet highway can be identified by the low rolling hills, tall **transmission towers**, and occasional [crop fields](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.199075,104.896833,3a,80.7y,327.2h,92.95t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sfLxOZ--sUVPnO4LI6oW8Mg!2e0) in the area. Additionally, most of the highway has **winter coverage** with the tentless car, light snow, and yellow grass. Beware that [summer coverage](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.115086,105.367769,3a,133.2y,119.6h,96.08t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sQyoCUbxBQtmvvlBhuYG0KA!2e0) can occasionally appear in the eastern half of the road.
text_zh: 達爾漢-額爾登特公路（Darkhan-Erdenet highway）可以透過低矮起伏的丘陵、高大的**輸電鐵塔**，以及該地區偶見的[農田](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.199075,104.896833,3a,80.7y,327.2h,92.95t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sfLxOZ--sUVPnO4LI6oW8Mg!2e0)來辨識。此外，這條公路大部分為**冬季街景**，配有無帳篷的 Google 車、薄雪與黃草。請注意，這條路的東半部偶爾會出現[夏季街景](https://www.google.com/maps/@49.115086,105.367769,3a,133.2y,119.6h,96.08t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sQyoCUbxBQtmvvlBhuYG0KA!2e0)。

text: North of Ulaanbaatar you can find this car, which has the same blue tent as the eastern tent, but with a **backwards-facing snorkel**. The snorkel can sometimes be difficult to see, so use other additional clues such as rolling hills and forests to confirm the region.

NOTE: The highway in pink can have either the blue tent car or the [tentless car with snow coverage](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.326546,106.221693,3a,133.2y,12.7h,98.90t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1so4HCVsdnYFYZfYe2PtP_Jw!2e0).
text_zh: 在烏蘭巴托北方可以找到這輛車，它擁有和東部帳篷相同的藍色帳篷，但配備了**朝後的呼吸管**。呼吸管有時很難看清楚，因此請利用起伏丘陵和森林等其他額外線索來確認區域。
注意：粉紅色標示的公路可能會出現藍色帳篷車，或是[帶有雪景的無帳篷車](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.326546,106.221693,3a,133.2y,12.7h,98.90t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1so4HCVsdnYFYZfYe2PtP_Jw!2e0)。

text: A Street View car with a **cage** on top of the roof instead of a tent can be seen near Ulaanbaatar. West of Ulaanbaatar, the car will have a [green camouflage sleeping bag](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.8967631,105.5177786,3a,31.5y,232.36h,46.83t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1ssX7pU24XafLnwz2a_NC7ug!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) on top of the cage (coverage highlighted in green). Additionally, all coverage with this car was taken during winter, with most of it being in snowy areas.

NOTE: The cage car can very rarely appear in [Kharkhorin](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.1827252,102.803768,2a,90y,224.36h,85.24t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sap6SFr1Io_8pnFMafcbQ-g!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu) and [Zuunmod](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.687993,106.94846,3a,133.2y,9.2h,93.60t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sPDrz82bCouVh_PsjAk81QQ!2e0).
text_zh: 車頂上方沒有帳篷而是放了個**鐵籠**的 Google 車可以在烏蘭巴托附近看到。在烏蘭巴托西方，該車的鐵籠上方會放一個[綠色迷彩睡袋](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.8967631,105.5177786,3a,31.5y,232.36h,46.83t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1ssX7pU24XafLnwz2a_NC7ug!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)（街景以綠色突顯）。此外，這輛車的所有街景都是在冬季拍攝的，大部分位於積雪地區。

注意：鐵籠車非常罕見地會出現在[哈拉和林](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.1827252,102.803768,2a,90y,224.36h,85.24t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sap6SFr1Io_8pnFMafcbQ-g!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?entry=ttu)與[宗莫德](https://www.google.com/maps/@47.687993,106.94846,3a,133.2y,9.2h,93.60t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1sPDrz82bCouVh_PsjAk81QQ!2e0)。

text: Erdenet is the second largest city in Mongolia. As such, it has many multistory buildings that can be seen from across town, a large stadium, and a **ferris wheel** in the south of the city. It is surrounded by large barren hills to the south and to the north, and was covered on a **cloudy day **in the** winter**, meaning all vegetation is dead.

NOTE: Erdenet can look very similar to Darkhan and Ulaanbaatar, but the lack of snow distinguishes it from [Darkhan](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zbywjh1bcnq3uP4B6), while the cloudy skies and lack of rubber inlays on the roof racks can be used to distinguish it from [Ulaanbaatar](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Zkw6E7f774cDFPj59).
text_zh: 額爾登特是蒙古第二大城。因此，它有許多從城鎮各處都能看見的多層樓建築、大型體育場，以及位於該市南方的**摩天輪**。城鎮南北兩側都被大型的貧瘠丘陵環繞，拍攝時正逢**冬季的陰天**，意味著所有植被都已枯死。
注意：額爾登特看起來可能非常像達爾漢和烏蘭巴托，但沒有積雪這點可以將它與[達爾漢](https://maps.app.goo.gl/zbywjh1bcnq3uP4B6)區分開來，而陰暗的天空以及車頂架上沒有橡膠嵌件，則可以用來將它與[烏蘭巴托](https://maps.app.goo.gl/Zkw6E7f774cDFPj59)區分開來。

text: The city of Darkhan in northern Mongolia can be recognized by its distinct **snow coverage**. It is the third largest city in Mongolia and as such has many high-rising buildings and travelling cars.

NOTE: Other smaller towns can also have snow coverage but Darkhan is the only large city in Mongolia with snow coverage, apart from some [Ulaanbaatar suburbs](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.066512,106.883211,3a,133.2y,313.2h,92.32t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1si8RI0T_bQ1km7-FMfeqK2w!2e0).
text_zh: 位於蒙古北方的達爾漢市可以透過其明顯的**雪地街景**來辨識。它是蒙古第三大城，因此有許多高樓大廈和行駛中的車輛。
注意：其他較小的城鎮也可能有雪地街景，但達爾漢是蒙古除了某些[烏蘭巴托郊區](https://www.google.com/maps/@48.066512,106.883211,3a,133.2y,313.2h,92.32t/data=!3m4!1e1!3m2!1si8RI0T_bQ1km7-FMfeqK2w!2e0)之外，唯一擁有雪地街景的大城市。

text: In the westmost part of Mongolia, there is some very remote coverage showcasing the tallest mountains in Mongolia where you can see glaciers and **snow-capped peaks**. This area also has a unique Street View car with a green or black bag above the right side roof racks.
text_zh: 在蒙古的最西部，有一些非常偏遠的街景覆蓋，展示了蒙古最高的山峰，你可以看到冰川和**雪山山頂**。這個地區還有一輛獨特的 Google 車，右側車頂行李架上方有一個綠色或黑色的袋子。

text: A lot of the coverage in the vicinity of Namche Bazar can be summarised as being sunny, with the trails going **close to the treeline**, meaning you will be either near the top of or just above a forest for most of this coverage. You will generally see barren or snowy mountains in some direction.
text_zh: 南崎巴扎（Namche Bazar）附近的許多街景可以總結為天氣晴朗，小徑**接近林木線**，這意味著在大部分的拍攝範圍中，你不是在森林邊緣就是剛好在森林上方。你通常會在某些方向看到荒涼的山脈或雪山。

text: Next to the village of Thame you can see this snowy, and **shining bright** mountain range.
text_zh: 在塔美村（Thame）旁，你可以看到這座積雪且**閃耀著明亮光芒**的山脈。

text: As you lose sight of the spiky mountains, you cross over a **glacier**, which is the largest patch of snow covered ground with coverage in the country.
text_zh: 當你看不見尖峭山脈時，你會跨越一座**冰河**，這是該國有街景覆蓋範圍中面積最大的覆雪地面。

text: New Zealand normally uses [**white outer**](https://goo.gl/maps/MqhaDyWhXhWWMwfSA)** road lines**. [Yellow dashed outer](https://goo.gl/maps/iwDpkjx7uvAhDnGm9) road lines can be seen in populated areas. Roads with [no outer lines](https://goo.gl/maps/8LJUn5zfzXnHXmZa8) can be seen on smaller roads. Inner lines are either a single dashed white line or unbroken double **yellow **lines.
NOTE: Australia does not have yellow inside lines, apart from regions with snow.
text_zh: 紐西蘭通常使用[**白色外側**](https://goo.gl/maps/MqhaDyWhXhWWMwfSA)**道路標線**。在人口稠密的地區可以看到[黃色虛線外側](https://goo.gl/maps/iwDpkjx7uvAhDnGm9)道路標線。較小的道路上可以看到[沒有外側標線](https://goo.gl/maps/8LJUn5zfzXnHXmZa8)的道路。內側標線則是單一白色虛線或連續的雙**黃色**實線。
注意：澳洲內部線條除了有雪的地區外，沒有黃色線條。

text: The Southern Alps, a **large, snowy mountain range,** stretches throughout the majority of the South Island. Vegetation on the mountains becomes rarer the further south it is.
text_zh: 南冰川山脈是一個**巨大且積雪的山脈，**貫穿了南島的大部分地區。越往南走，山上的植被就越稀疏。

text: Mount Taranaki, formerly known as Mount Egmont, is easily distinguished due to its relatively **smooth slopes** and its pointed, often snowy peak. It can frequently be identified from afar, as the surrounding area is flat.
text_zh: 塔拉納基山（前稱埃格蒙特山）以其相對**平緩的山坡**和尖銳且經常覆蓋著積雪的山頂而容易辨識。由於周邊地區相當平坦，它經常可以從遠處被識別出來。

text: Part of State Highway 85 in Otago has **light snow coverage, **specifically between the towns of Becks and Morisson.
text_zh: 奧塔哥的 85 號國道有一部分有**微量的積雪，**特別是在貝克斯和莫里森兩個城鎮之間。

text: State Highway 94 is characterised by its dense** **[**red beech**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nothofagus_fusca)** forest **surrounded by **snow-capped mountains**.
text_zh: 94 號省道（State Highway 94）的特徵是周圍環繞著被**雪山**包圍的茂密[**紅山毛櫸**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Nothofagus_fusca)**森林**。

text: State Highway 80 in the Southern Alps is recognizable by its north-south orientation up a **glacial valley**. The west side of the road is lined with snow-capped mountains, while the east side of the road runs alongside the Tasman River and Lake Pukaki.
text_zh: 南阿爾卑斯山的80號省道（State Highway 80）具有南北走向的**冰川谷**地形，因而容易辨識。道路西側綿延著覆蓋積雪的山脈，東側則與塔斯曼河（Tasman River）和普卡基湖（Lake Pukaki）並行。

text: This **wide open valley** with lightly snow capped mountains can be seen on the west side of South Georgia Island.
text_zh: 這個有著微雪覆頂山峰的**寬闊山谷**可以在南喬治亞島的西側看到。

text: The mountain range of Sierra Nevada features **snowy peaks** through the months of November and May. Sierra Nevada is the only mountain range in south Spain with snow during most of the year.
text_zh: 內華達山脈（Sierra Nevada）在 11 月到 5 月期間會出現**積雪山峰**。內華達山脈是西班牙南部唯一一座一年中大部分時間都有積雪的山脈。

text: The E10 between Kiruna and the Norwegian border is a major road which can be recognised by the vegetation mainly consisting of **small birches**, occasionally with some [pines](https://maps.app.goo.gl/r2w5fSrjknpLRGbg9) strewn in, combined with snow covered mountains, which can typically be seen in the distant west close to Kiruna, and in all directions when you approach the border. A [major lake](https://maps.app.goo.gl/5ufEBehSjqCDNzoB8) can also be seen to the north on the western half of the road.
text_zh: 基律納（Kiruna）與挪威邊境之間的 E10 是一條主要道路，其特徵是植被主要由**小型樺樹**組成，偶爾參雜一些[松樹](https://maps.app.goo.gl/r2w5fSrjknpLRGbg9)，並結合積雪的山脈；這些山脈通常可以在靠近基律納的遠處西方看到，而在你接近邊境時則四面八方都能看到。在道路的西半部北方，也可以看到一個[大湖泊](https://maps.app.goo.gl/5ufEBehSjqCDNzoB8)。

text: Road 95 west of Arjeplog can be recognised by the Generation 4 **thawing snow** coverage in a **mountainous landscape**. The amount of snow significantly decreases as you go [further east](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LKbMcdV7kLzYfx7n8).
text_zh: 阿爾耶普卢格（Arjeplog）西側的 95 號公路可以透過**山地景觀**中的 Generation 4 **融雪**街景覆蓋來識別。當你[往東走](https://maps.app.goo.gl/LKbMcdV7kLzYfx7n8)時，雪量會顯著減少。

text: The city of Umeå has a lot of Generation 4 spring coverage, with dirty piles of **thawing snow** along almost every road. Almost no other city in the country has similar coverage.
text_zh: 于默奧市有很多 Generation 4 春季街景覆蓋，幾乎每條道路旁都有髒亂的**融雪**堆。該國幾乎沒有其他城市有類似的覆蓋。

text: **Generation 2** coverage is very limited in Switzerland. It can be found mostly near the border between the cantons of Bern and Valais, and on a few very short stretches in Schaffhausen.
NOTE: This does not include the many ski resorts with Generation 2 snow coverage, which can be found throughout the southern half of the country.
text_zh: 瑞士的**第二代（Generation 2）**街景覆蓋非常有限。它主要分佈在伯恩州和瓦萊州的交界附近，以及沙夫豪森的幾個極短路段上。
註：這不包含位於南部半境各地、擁有第二代雪地街景覆蓋的眾多滑雪勝地。

text: The Mount Kilimanjaro tripods show a **high altitude landscape**, with [dark grey rock](https://goo.gl/maps/Nmh8gJ1qkczsbrhGA) and in some places [eternal snow](https://goo.gl/maps/DuuFbspLtcPGZmqa6) in the distance. In some panos, you will see mountaineers and [tents](https://goo.gl/maps/SFEq7AFLiejDffT79).
text_zh: 吉力馬札羅山的三腳架拍攝點展現了**高海拔景觀**，遠處有[深灰色岩石](https://goo.gl/maps/Nmh8gJ1qkczsbrhGA)，有些地方甚至有[萬年積雪](https://goo.gl/maps/DuuFbspLtcPGZmqa6)。在某些全景圖中，你會看到登山客和[帳篷](https://goo.gl/maps/SFEq7AFLiejDffT79)。
